CycloneDX JSON schemas copied from github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-go v0.12.0 (`schema/`), which
copies them from github.com/CycloneDX/specification. Apache-2.0, see LICENSE. Test fixtures only;
not compiled into bellud. `jsf-0.82.schema.json` is `jsf-0.82.schemax.json` renamed to match its `$id`.
`cryptography-defs.schema.json` (needed by 1.7) is from github.com/CycloneDX/specification, tag 1.7, same license.

`spdx-2.3.schema.json` is `schemas/spdx-schema.json` from github.com/spdx/spdx-spec, branch
`support/v2.3` (the SPDX 2.3.1 JSON schema, draft 2019-09), fetched 2026-11-25. The spec repository is
licensed CC-BY-3.0, see `LICENSE-spdx-spec`. Test fixture only; not compiled into bellud. It is not
`spdx.schema.json`, which is CycloneDX's license-id enum.
